copy.headline: DFW Airport prepares for 3.1 million travelers during Thanksgiving rush
copy.caption: DFW Airport expects about 3.1 million travelers to pass through between now and Dec. 1. That passenger volume is up nearly 5% compared to last year's holiday travel season.
